description: Implement a single task from a Go `implementation_plan.md`-style task list — just the implementation and its tests — in any Go module: an agent-friendly command-line tool (Cobra, optional Bubble Tea v2 terminal UI) scaffolded by `iru-setup-go-cli`, or any other Go library, service or CLI. Detects at runtime the module path and `go` version from `go.mod` (and a `go.work` workspace), the `cmd/<bin>/` vs root-`main.go` layout and the `internal/` packages, the CLI framework (Cobra, urfave/cli, kong, or none), Bubble Tea/Lip Gloss and their import paths, the test harness (standard `testing`, testscript `testdata/script/*.txtar` driven by `TestMain`, teatest, testify/go-cmp if already used, container tests behind the `integration` build tag), the golangci-lint config, and `//go:generate` directives, then loads only the matching guidance from this skill's own `reference/` directory (always: Go code style — Effective Go/Code Review Comments, package naming, `internal/`, small consumer-side interfaces, `context.Context` first — and errors — `%w` wrapping, `errors.Is`/`As`/`AsType`, sentinel vs typed errors, exit-code mapping in one place; as needed: testing — table tests, `t.Parallel` caveats, golden files with `-update`, testscript, Cobra in-process tests, teatest —, the shared CLI contract, Cobra, output/TTY/colour/signals/EPIPE, Bubble Tea v2, the catalog's UI contract on Bubble Tea when a task touches the terminal UI — composed sub-models, typed intent messages, Bubbles lists/tables rendering only what fits, state × direction × theme UI tests captured as `.txt` into `.ui-screenshots/`, asserted accessibility checks at the `.ui-quality.yml` level —, doc comments, security — argv-only `exec.CommandContext`, `--` before operands, `os.Root` —, and concurrency — errgroup, cancellation, no leaks). Re-checks the current code state, implements exactly what the task specifies, writes/updates the tests next to the code, formats the touched files (`gofmt`/`goimports`) and compile-checks with `go build ./...` plus `go vet` on the touched packages (test files included), then — if the task didn't stop on a blocker — immediately checks off this task's own checkbox (and its sub-tasks') in `implementation_plan.md` with a "group validation pending" note, before handing back a short summary. Does not capture a quality baseline, add license headers, audit doc comments beyond the code it writes, or run tests, coverage, golangci-lint or govulncheck — those happen once per task group in `iru-go-code-one-task-group`, which invokes this skill once per task (in parallel when the group allows it, through `iru-isolated-skill-executor`). Invoke as `/iru-go-code-one-task <task description>`, passing the task's own text — including its exact `implementation_plan.md` checkbox line(s) — as the argument. For plan tasks tagged `go`.
